metadata.datasource: https://125px.com/docs/film/fuji/astia_100f_datasheet.pdf; PDF SHA256 a3ed5826d934743b91d750a7ce6c79041c8b3ba0b1afc05ff3cf0b8d175e0809; source SHA256 7bc6f150ba595c3c49e3f7ecdad3f0c1f807e716c15156db30000110e6a8b5c5. ASTIA 100F RAP100F; daylight, 1/50 second; E-6/CR-56; Fuji FAD-30S (Status A). Rebuild scripts/prepare_astia100f.py; see docs/astia100f.md. Publication drawing, not batch-specific measurements. Separated-light dye shapes act as additive basis spectra; base removal not specified. No independently measured clear-film spectrum or nonneutral layer coupling. Outside plotted domains, spectral tails require assumptions. Neutral clear-end prior plus residual dye minima is inferred, not a measured base spectrum. Status A uses legacy response tables, 1 nm log-linear interpolation and Simpson projection to the 5 nm transmission grid, not certified ISO 5-3 weights. Monotone dye amounts regularize small publication drawing reversals; no extrapolated exposure latitude. Sensitivity log-slope and dye linear tails are assumptions outside plotted support; outward growth is prevented. Each aggregate CMY record is a numerical effective dye amount, not a measured emulsion sublayer. MCCL/HTILE and nonneutral exposure coupling are not identified by the available one-dimensional plots. D55 is an implementation daylight convention; RGB midgray exposure normalization is not absolute ISO calibration. Input-adapter training and holdout measure spectral reconstruction, not matched physical film or scanner fidelity. No calibrated stock-specific grain, halation, DIR or MTF; builtin preset disables unmeasured effects.
